case_description: 62-year-old with known HFrEF (LVEF 32%) presented with progressive dyspnea over 5 days, mild lower extremity edema, weight gain 6 lbs. Received IV furosemide 80mg in ED. Now improved subjectively, ambulating without distress, satting 96% on RA. Has access to outpatient pharmacy and reliable transportation. Established HF clinic at Temple, can be seen within 5 days.
clinical_question: For this patient with known HFrEF who improved after ED diuresis and is being considered for discharge, what medication ensemble is most defensible to prevent near-term worsening or readmission?
